messages:
Anika: Quick sync: proposing canary sampling schedule + forced rollback criteria for FP8/INT8 rollouts. TL;DR: short canary at 0.5% traffic, shadow sampling + periodic human check, automatic rollback if quality degradation > 2% absolute or SNR drop > 4 dB over 5k requests.
Matt: SG. Can you paste the canary config? Also how do we calculate SNR here?
Anika: Here's an example canary config I'm suggesting:
```yaml
canary:
  sampling_rate: 0.005  # 0.5%
  shadow_sampling: 0.05 # 5% to run shadow and collect fidelity
  min_requests: 5000
  monitor:
    quality_metric: "deg_score"  # normalized degradation score
    quality_threshold: 0.02      # 2% absolute degradation triggers action
    snr_drop_db: 4.0             # 4 dB drop
  hysteresis:
    min_window_secs: 1800       # 30 minutes
    min_requests_window: 1000
  rollback_policy:
    catastrophic: # immediate full rollback
      latency_p95_ms: 300
      error_rate_pct: 1.0
    staged: # reduce, pause, full
      step_reduce: 0.5
      pause_secs: 1200 # 20 minutes
```
Anika: SNR calculation: compare log-likelihood ratio on a held calibration set vs baseline; or simpler signal-to-noise on embedding distances in our eval harness.
Sam: We should avoid relying on exact_match or single brittle metrics. Use a small ensemble: deg_score + BLEU-ish proxy + latency. Also add bootstrapped CI for the deg_score.
Lee: For hysteresis, propose min time window 30m and min requests=1k; also a staged rollback: partial reduction -> full rollback. Avoid flapping during traffic spikes.
Anika: Agreed. Updated playbook: 3-stage rollback. If catastrophic (latency p95 >300ms or error rate >1%) -> immediate full rollback and page on-call. For non-catastrophic quality regression -> cut sample in half, page, wait 20m, if still > threshold then full rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy started: model=redwood-mosaic-fp8-v2 canary=0.5% shadow=5%
Sam: We need telemetry labels to link requests to quant profile. Add header/tracing tag: "X-Quant-Profile: fp8-v2" and log line example.
Matt: Example trace/log format please.
Anika: Log example:
```json
{"ts": "...", "req_id": "abc123", "quant_profile": "fp8-v2", "deg_score": 0.013, "snr_db": -1.2}
```
Lee: One more: mixed-precision per-layer — per-request or per-token? I vote per-request for canary simplicity.
Sam: Per-request simpler for initial rollout; per-token is future optimization. Let's gate per-token experiments behind an infra flag and separate shadowing.
Anika: OK. I'll update the RFC follow-up doc, add the playbook to runbooks, and open a PR to require canary config for any quant-profile change. Also add a lint rule for missing monitoring fields.
Matt: :thumbsup:
Anika: Thanks all — will post links when PRs are up.
